resources.string:
In Termux:

1. pkg install tmux
2. echo "allow-external-apps=true" >> ~/.termux/termux.properties
3. termux-reload-settings
4. Tap "Open Claude" to start the tmux session (default name: claude).

The adb chip checks 127.0.0.1:5555. If it shows closed (after a reboot), tap "Reconnect": the app turns Wireless debugging back on, then runs "quest up" in Ubuntu, which finds its port and reopens 5555. First time only: pair Ubuntu's adb with "quest pair" (see README).

"Remote" starts claude remote-control in its own tmux session (claude-rc), so you can drive the headset from claude.ai on another device.
